implemented_extension.l1_identity: sum_i |f_i(s)| = max over sigma in {-1,+1}^N of sum_i sigma_i f_i(s)

implemented_extension.termination: finite anchor candidates, finite rational sector checks and finite 2^N residual orthant positivity decisions; timeout and resource refusal remain non-truth outcomes
implemented_extension.precedence: v8-v21 retain ownership of every source they already certify; v22 is considered only after historical authority remains blocked
